text:
sara: ALERT: Starting an incident — we're seeing TLS handshake failures at the eu-west1 auth ingress since ~09:03UTC. A subset of token issuance calls are failing with 495/502. Initial impact estimate ~1.5% of total requests, mostly hosted API clients. Investigating now. :red_circle:
incident-bot: Public status updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3287654321  investigating.
leo: Oncall here. Looking at LB cert metrics; it looks like an automated cert rotation job failed overnight and one edge group is serving an expired cert. Pulling certs and validating chain.
maria: Confirmed expired cert on eu-west1-edge-b. Cert expired 2026-03-22T23:59:59Z. Starting emergency cert rotation using standby cert pair. ETA ~8 minutes for rotation + rolling health checks.
security-bot: Notifying InfoSec on rotation. Marking incident as P2 until token flows recover.
ops-bot: Rotation job kicked off for eu-west1-edge-b at 09:12UTC (job id: cert-rotate-3287). Health probes will run during rolling restart.
jamal: Adding temporary client fallback: auth clients will accept the standby CA root for requests routed from eu-west until rotation completes. This reduces strict handshake failures but may show higher TLS negotiation latency for some routes.
incident-bot: Internal post with runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/ingress-cert-rotation-urgent. Public page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3287654321
maria: Rotation complete on eu-west1-edge-b at 09:19UTC. Health checks green. Observability shows TLS handshake 5xxs down 94% from peak. Token issuance success up to 99.8% for shifted traffic.
leo: Reverting temporary fallback and validating client telemetry. Will keep extra monitoring for 20 minutes.
ops-bot: Canary checks passed across eu-west1 edge groups at 09:24UTC. No further expired certs detected.
sara: Current summary for ops channel: cause = failed automated cert rotation -> expired cert presented by one edge group; mitigation = emergency rotation to standby certs + temporary client fallback; impact = brief token failures (~1.5% peak), now reduced to <0.05%.
jamal: Outreach note prepared for affected customers and PGs. Draft: "We experienced brief auth failures in EU due to a certificate rotation issue. Services recovered after rotation at 09:19UTC. No customer data exposure. Full RCA to follow."
security-bot: Incident logged for post-incident review and SRE/Sec sync.
incident-bot: Next automated status update scheduled in 30m or on significant change.
sara: Thanks everyone. Please add any follow-ups or telemetry dashboards to the incident page. We'll run a postmortem and publish RCA within 48 hours. :white_check_mark:
